7.
Details  of  all  loans  raised,  money  retained  in  the
accounts maintained at the Central Bank of Sri Lanka or at a
licensed commerical bank and the settlement of obligations
of the Government made under the provisions of this Act
shall  be  incorporated  in  the  reports  relating  to  the
Government’s fiscal performance, which are required to be
tabled  in  Parliament  under  the  Fiscal  Management
(Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003.

8.
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any other
written law, all documents or instruments made or used under
the provisions of this Act shall be free from stamp duty.
